voice.name: Martin - Ultra High Quality
voice.why: A calm, easy French voice for Odilon Ferrand, the retired ferryman on the square's bench: unhurried, a man with all afternoon to talk. Used by no other NPC.

greet.text: Well now, a new face on the square. Sit, sit. Colin and I see everything from this bench.

town.text: Saint-Philippe is small. Everyone knows who paid the baker and who did not, and Colin knows twice as much.

barn.text: They say the old still barn is not empty at night. Lights, and a truck with no plates. I say nothing.

more.text: There is more, if you have the time. What would you like to hear?

bell.text: The church bell rings on the hour, and I set my watch by it. The priest oils the rope himself, you know.

courier.text: The Courier is a dollar at the newsstand. Read it before you talk to anyone, and you will sound clever.

mine.text: They are digging coal again at East Rise. Hard work, honest pay. My knees say no, thank you.

more2.text: Still listening? Good. A man needs an audience.

market.text: The market is where the apples go. Sell at the stalls, never to the first man who names a price.

hostel.text: The hostel clerk is kind to strangers. A bed, a key, and a car if you ask nicely. Everyone starts there.

who.text: Odilon Ferrand, retired from the ferry. Forty years of watching people come and go. Now I watch them stay.

again.text: Anything else? My bench is free.

bye.text: Come back when you have news. I will pay in coffee. Or in secrets.

replies.barn: Heard anything about the old barn?
replies.bell: Tell me about the church bell.
